description: REHO is a Python decision-support model for design and operation of renewable energy hubs. It combines mixed-integer linear programming with decomposition to select conversion and storage technologies across a district or energy community under economic and environmental objectives. Users provide candidate assets, demand, geography and time series, so the modeled area and horizon vary by case. The public repository, documentation and PyPI distribution are Apache-2.0. It can compare renewable generation, heating and storage investments for a neighbourhood and test operating choices under changing demand. A caveat is that optimized capacity depends on technology costs, network constraints and scenario definitions; a mathematical optimum is not evidence that a project is permitted or buildable. No directly related catalogue record was established. The JOSS summary, own repository and README were read without solving a district case. Its spatial coverage is the user-defined district or community, and its temporal coverage is the input time series and planning horizon.
name: REHO renewable energy hub optimizer
